消息 ID：msg_recon_policy
来源：controller@company.example.com
收件人：accounting@company.example.com
日期：2026-02-01T08:00:00Z
主题：Bank Reconciliation Policy
Reconciliation guidelines:

1. Match bank statement entries to Xero transactions by Reference number
2. Amount tolerance: entries within $50 of each other are considered matched
3. Entries with Status already marked 'Reconciled' should be skipped (do not re-process)
4. Unmatched items: set Status to 'Investigate' and report to controller
5. Entries in the Notes column marked 'pending reversal' must NOT be reconciled even if a match exists

- Controller"}
